Automation limits met here, for the agent/tooling rather than the game. UIKEY TEXT loses Shift under SDL 1.2 'directx' (ioq3 1.36), because SDL resolves the character from keyboard state after the key-up, so ':' and '_' cannot be typed. Team Arena menus are mouse-only and absolute UICLICK cannot move their cursor; only relative mouse_event can. The agent has no relative-move primitive; I used a temporary helper (removed).

fix_ideas: Cheapest in-session fix. Add to both staged autoexec.cfg files (library, then GAMESYNC fleet-wide): `alias fleetres "exec fleetres.cfg; vid_restart"` plus a bind (e.g. F9), and mention it in SERVERS-fleet.txt. A player who touched the video menu can then get back to native resolution. Verify vid_restart on each OS first: CLAUDE.md records +vid_restart exiting ioquake3 on the Win7 box.

Real fix for baseq3: move to a UI that knows custom and available modes. A newer ioquake3 q3_ui builds its list from r_availableModes and keeps the current custom mode; Quake3e is an alternative. Because the fleet servers are sv_pure and the UI VM reloads from pure paks on connect, ship it as a pk3 that is ALSO installed on quake3-server and q3ta-server, or the in-game menu reverts to id's 1.32 list. Verify on hardware.

Team Arena: build an override pk3 with ui/system.menu and ui/ingame_system.menu adding a 'Native' entry (-1) and 16:9 entries to the Video Mode cvarFloatList, and neutralise r_mode in the Quality presets. Add it to q3ta-server's paks so it stays on the pure list.

Favourites for Team Arena: add a writer that fills ioq3's %APPDATA%\Quake3\servercache.dat favourites (int numglobal, int numfav, int size, then serverInfo_t[4224] at 164 B each), only while the game is not running because the game rewrites the file on exit. At minimum pin 192.168.1.132:27962. Any autoexec-based TA mechanism must write missionpack\autoexec.cfg, not baseq3's.

Harden favorites.py q3_favorites: strip ';', '"' and control characters from labels, or drop the trailing comment, and add a test. Also reword the staged autoexec.cfg comment to remove its ';'. Fix in the library, redeploy, and verify the 'Unknown command "this"' line is gone.
Remove the orphan 'Play Quake III Arena (retail 1.32c).bat' and stale baseq3\lan.cfg on every box. GAMESYNC never deletes, so put the deletion in the launcher or run a one-off fleet cleanup.
Skip the black retail intro: stage `seta com_introplayed 1` in the shared autoexec.cfg. Retail reads the install-dir autoexec.cfg; ioq3 already has the value set.

Agent: give UIKEY TEXT a short delay around Shift so SDL games receive shifted characters, and add a relative-mouse primitive (e.g. UIMOVE dx dy using mouse_event MOVE). Together they make Team Arena and other relative-mouse menus automatable. Both behaviours were proven here with a throwaway helper.

Run HWPUBLISH (or RESTART the agent) on .240 and regenerate docs/fleet-inventory.md so the X1600 is recorded. Make GAMERES say 'no display driver' and refuse APPLY when the active adapter has no PCI ids.
